quote: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stand or park a bus at a bus stop or an origin or destination point for a period of time longer than has been designated for such bus stop or origin or destination point in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010].

activation.condition: Operator of a bus other than a tour bus at a bus stop or origin or destination point.

obligation.description: Do not stand or park longer than the period designated for that place under Section 11.60.010.

exceptions.effect: Excluded from this paragraph; original bus classification requires review.

timing.description: Measure the complete original bus standing or parking interval and compare only after applicable designated period is sourced.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: designated for such bus stop or origin or destination point in accordance with Section 11.60.010
judgment_calls_needed.note: Require original applicable authority, exact endpoint and effective designated period; a marker without a time is insufficient.
